judgement.impact: The user cannot know about the 50% OFF TODAY promotion that is only conveyed in the image text.
User hears only generic Submit and cannot tell at the point of action that it will pay R1,249.
The screen-reader user cannot know the card number field is flagged as invalid and will try to pay without correcting it.
The user cannot know the button deletes/clears payment information and may activate it expecting to close something, risking unintended data loss.
The user hears only 'Click here' in the agreement sentence and cannot know the link opens the Terms before paying.
User hears 'Total:' with no amount and cannot confirm the final charge before paying.
Screen-reader user hears only "Button" and cannot identify or confidently use the Pay with wallet payment option.
